limitations: Text heuristics do not understand dataflow, helper functions, decorators, middleware, or database query semantics.
A visible tenant string is not proof of correct tenant scoping.
No API requests or database operations are executed.
Production clearance requires code review and live cross-tenant read/write tests in a disposable environment.
